mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_knowledge_create_receipts(tenant_id,request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint) VALUES(#{tenant},CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_knowledge_create_receipts SET kb_id=#{kbId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND kb_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,kb_id FROM nw_knowledge_create_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
